name: Veritas Governance Kit
description: Installable governance workflows and agent guidance backed by the standalone @kontourai/veritas readiness engine.

flows.description: Gate a repository change on the canonical Veritas software-readiness verdict.
Review and approve a Veritas Repo Standards authoring plan before applying it.

skills.description: Install or detect the Veritas CLI, author Repo Standards, configure hooks, attest the baseline, and run initial readiness.
Pull just-in-time repo governance guidance from the Veritas engine before editing.
Derive and human-review Repo Standards through the standards-authoring flow.

docs.description: Git installation, activation, engine setup, and readiness-gate guide.

supersedes: npm exec -- veritas hooks codex pre-tool-use

VERITAS_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; VERITAS_PREFIX=; VERITAS_FOUND=; VERITAS_DIR="$(pwd -P 2>/dev/null)"; while :; do case "$VERITAS_DIR" in /*) ;; *) break;; esac; if [ -z "$VERITAS_FOUND" ] && [ -f "$VERITAS_DIR/node_modules/@kontourai/veritas/package.json" ]; then VERITAS_FOUND="$VERITAS_DIR"; fi; if [ -n "$VERITAS_ROOT" ] && [ "$VERITAS_DIR" -ef "$VERITAS_ROOT" ]; then VERITAS_PREFIX="$VERITAS_FOUND"; break; fi; if [ "$VERITAS_DIR" = / ]; then break; fi; VERITAS_DIR="${VERITAS_DIR%/*}"; [ -n "$VERITAS_DIR" ] || VERITAS_DIR=/; done; if [ -n "$VERITAS_PREFIX" ]; then npx --no --prefix "$VERITAS_PREFIX" @kontourai/veritas hooks codex pre-tool-use; else npx --no @kontourai/veritas hooks codex pre-tool-use; fi
provisions.description: Codex PreToolUse hook that asks Veritas for path-specific guidance before file edits.
